description: This file defines the CollectionData class representing various financial and delinquency metrics related to loan collections in the Fineract project. It includes fields for amounts, dates, and delinquency periods, along with a static method for creating a template instance.

classes.name: CollectionData
classes.description: Immutable data class encapsulating loan collection and delinquency details, with Lombok annotations for boilerplate code reduction.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Creates and returns a default instance of CollectionData with zeroed amounts and null dates.
